rules.position: Two positions with no stated uncertainty are inconsistent when they are more than 2 arcsec apart; when one states an error radius, the separation is compared with 3 times that radius.

publication_revisions.abstract: We report 3 TDE candidates identified in WFST photometry and selected using TTC, a Transformer-based classifier (Zheng et al. 2026, ApJ, 999, 181; doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae3153). All candidates passed TTC selection and manual inspection of their light curves and host galaxies. They are high-probability TDE candidates, none of which has yet been spectroscopically confirmed. We provide their coordinates, discovery epochs, and color information, and encourage spectroscopic and multiwavelength follow-up.
